text:
Noah (AE): NorthWave is ready to run a 2-week POC. Ask: Dedicated GPU pool + VPC peering + control-plane mTLS. Region request: ap-southeast1. Target peak ~500 rps, avg 180 rps, payload ~1200 tokens. Need quick sizing + availability.
Lina (SE): For ~1.2k context, H100 preferred for latency headroom. Ballpark: 12x H100 to target ~500 rps p99 <250ms; 16x A100 could get close but with higher latency.
Ops (Provisioning): Quick checklist we need from customer: tenant_name, tenant_cidr, peer_project_id, service_account_email, CSR for mTLS, desired start date. Also H100 inventory in ap-southeast is currently constrained.
Ivy (AM): I'll ask NorthWave (contact: ops@northwave.ai) for CIDR and confirm if they'd accept a short reserved commit for the POC (discount applies).
Samir (Security): mTLS supported. We'll need their CSR and the subjectAltName details. If they require a private control-plane (no public control plane traffic), that's an extended engagement (~3-4 weeks) and requires legal/security signoff.
ticket-bot: Ops payload template to paste into provisioning ticket:
{
  "tenant_name": "northwave-poc",
  "pool_sku": "H100",
  "region": "ap-southeast1",
  "gpu_count": "12",
  "tenant_cidr": "10.70.0.0/22",
  "peer_project_id": "northwave-prod",
  "service_account_email": "sa-northwave@northwave.ai",
  "csr_pem": "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----\\n...\\n-----END CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----"
}
Lina (SE): I'll draft two options (cost/perf): 12x H100 vs 16x A100 and a cheaper trial: 8x A100 with autoscale for traffic characterization. Ops, can you run an availability probe for H100 and ETA for additional capacity?
Ops (Provisioning): Running probe now. Expect update in 24h. If H100 unavailable we propose the A100+more-gpus path and show cost delta.
Noah (AE): Thanks team. Ivy I'll share this thread with NorthWave and collect the CIDR/CSR. Lina please drop perf bullets once ready. Samir attach the minimal security checklist.
Ivy (AM): On it :thumbsup:
